name: Fleet Response
summary: Nationwide commercial fleet maintenance, mechanical repair and roadside towing management.
evidenceNote: Official maintenance page offers guaranteed nationwide fleet pricing, major mechanical repairs including engines and transmissions, and 24-hour roadside assistance that explicitly includes towing. Placements are limited to managed commercial fleet service; no consumer repair shop or local tow yard is claimed.

name: Fleet Response
summary: Nationwide commercial fleet collision-repair and claims-management network.
evidenceNote: Official claims page states Fleet Response coordinates repairs through more than 5,000 certified body shops nationwide and manages the collision-repair process through vehicle return. Placements retain commercial fleet and insurer program scope; no directly owned local body shop is inferred.

name: Wheels
summary: Nationwide managed fleet maintenance, repair and roadside towing service.
evidenceNote: Official fleet-maintenance page states nationwide urban, suburban and rural coverage through more than 43,000 vetted repair facilities, with ASE-guided repairs and roadside assistance including towing. These are managed business-fleet services; consumer walk-in availability is not asserted.

name: Holman
summary: North American commercial fleet repair, towing and collision-repair management.
evidenceNote: Official fleet-management page describes more than 100,000 repair vendors across North America, mechanical repair anytime and anywhere, roadside and towing coordination, and scheduling and monitoring collision repairs through completion. Placements are for enrolled commercial fleets, not retail auto shops.

name: Element Fleet Management
summary: Commercial fleet accident and collision-repair management through a national shop network.
evidenceNote: Official U.S. risk-management page says Element manages accident cases from first notice through repair and provides national repair coverage through more than 2,900 contracted shops. Placements reflect commercial fleet programs; no directly owned body shop or consumer retail service is claimed.

name: Nextech
summary: Nationwide commercial kitchen and foodservice equipment repair.
evidenceNote: Official equipment page states nationwide commercial kitchen, beverage and foodservice-equipment service, repair and maintenance and names ovens, cooking systems, dishwashers, ice machines and refrigeration equipment. Placements are commercial appliance repair; residential service is not inferred.

name: Door Systems
summary: Nationwide commercial overhead-door, dock-door and garage-door repair.
evidenceNote: Official national-accounts page offers nationwide dock and door service through local technicians, including 24/7 emergency repair, all-brand replacement and stocked parts. Placements retain commercial national-account scope; a residential garage-door branch in every city is not asserted.

name: Triton Liners
summary: Mobile marine fuel-tank rebuilding and repair in all 50 states.
evidenceNote: Official service-area page states Triton Liners is a fully mobile business providing onsite marine fuel-tank repair nationwide in all 50 states. Listings represent specialized mobile boat-tank repair coverage; no marina, boatyard or storefront in each city is claimed.

name: Armor Screen
summary: Nationwide residential and commercial hurricane-screen protection projects.
evidenceNote: Official website identifies Miami-Dade-approved Category 5 hurricane screens, an in-house team plus nationwide authorized dealers, and residential and commercial project coverage nationwide. Placements are for hurricane-screen systems within the hurricane-protection category; impact-window installation is not claimed.
